evals.name: architecture_contract
evals.prompt: User gives product specs, target country, and price range, then asks for a full GTM dashboard after an interrupted run.
must_include: create or resume GTM Run State
select quick, standard, real_product_pilot, or deep mode
must_not_include: require optional private files before starting
open all upstream full artifacts by default
show S14 as a visible business module
write the final HTML like a workflow log
show report audience labels in the main report
lead the report with input coverage or private-data boundary proof
use contrastive wording such as 而不是 or 不是...而是 in dashboard-facing conclusions
make absolute recommendations without evidence scope or validation caveats
